title: PHP Beginner Mock Test 1
description: Comprehensive 50-minute mock examination for PHP at beginner level.

questions.prompt: Which statement accurately describes strict types in PHP?

options.text: strict_types limits scalar coercion for calls from the declaring file
declare it in typed application source
it does not validate HTTP input automatically
PHP automatically repairs the issue

questions.explanation: strict_types limits scalar coercion for calls from the declaring file. Confirm with linting, focused tests, and observable failure handling.
